decision.next_responsible_human_decision: Decide whether the unresolved resource scale warrants a separately frozen score-blind support, missingness and exclusion policy before any operational allocation state or collection is authorized.
decision.reason: V3 balances every complete contiguous issued prefix, and a contiguous 90% prefix retains that property. Non-contiguous session or trial loss does not preserve the strict schedule invariant deterministically, while exposure-phase and source-correlated loss show that a scalar 90% usable-rate assumption cannot prove candidate-position balance or source support.
